items.reason: The truthiness checks at packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:104 and :110 are unchanged from base-version lines 99 and 105, so dropping zero-valued filters is not introduced by this PR. EventType and User IDs also use autoincrement defaults (packages/prisma/schema.prisma:87 and :312), rather than normally generating ID 0.

packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:154 initializes teamIds with options.orgId before adding child-team IDs. Consequently, the array passed to ANY at line 164 is never empty, even when the organization has no child teams, contradicting the issue's premise.

The new public type makes teamId optional at packages/lib/server/service/insightsBooking.ts:29-34 and is accepted by the constructor at line 58, although the team schema requires it at line 25. Omitting it now compiles but fails safeParse at lines 62-63 and silently produces 1=0 at lines 125-127; this confirms the second comment, although validation prevents the undefined interpolation alleged by the first.
